subject: Re: Lifewell demo timing — vendor intake gating
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@lifewellhealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T14:10:00Z
Subject: Lifewell — scheduling for product demo

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the invite — we’re excited to see Redwood in action. Procurement asked that we run your team through our vendor intake before the demo. They flagged the standard supplier governance questionnaire and want a current SOC2 attestation (or an approved alternative).

I’m looping in procurement (procurement@lifewellhealth.com) to share the intake doc. Can we hold the live demo until the intake is complete? If you prefer, we could do a short commercial walkthrough for our product team while procurement completes the paperwork.

Attached: lifewell_vendor_intake.pdf (vendor intake form)

Best,
Samantha Reed
Head of IT Programs
Lifewell Health
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@lifewellhealth.com>
Cc: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-02T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Lifewell — scheduling for product demo

On Tue, Jun 1, 2027 at 14:10 Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@lifewellhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the invite — we’re excited to see Redwood in action. Procurement asked that we run your team through our vendor intake before the demo.

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the form.

We’re happy to pause the full technical demo until procurement clears the vendor intake. To help speed things up, I attached our vendor checklist (redwood_vendor_checklist.xlsx) which maps out the usual artifacts procurement asks for:
- Signed mutual NDA or MSA clause (we can countersign)
- Current SOC2 Type II report OR self-attested security questionnaire responses
- Data handling summary and retention policy
- Contact for technical references / smoke-test account

If it helps, we can schedule a 20-minute intake call between Lifewell procurement and our security lead to go through questions line-by-line — procurement often prefers that. If procurement is comfortable proceeding, we can offer two alternative demo windows:
- Tue, June 15, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed, June 16, 14:00–15:00 PT

Otherwise we’ll keep the demo on ice until we receive the completed intake. Let us know what preferred path is.

—Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: procurement@lifewellhealth.com
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-02T11:05:00Z
Subject: Lifewell vendor intake: Redwood follow-up

Hi Laura / Mateo,

Thanks for the checklist. Procurement assigned intake ID LVW-2027-881. A couple of clarifying asks from our side before we clear a live demo:
1) Can Redwood provide a redacted SOC2 Type II or a completed security questionnaire (we attached a copy of the sections we need answered)?
2) Is there an NDA template you can sign this week? We prefer a mutual NDA signed prior to any PII-related walkthroughs.
3) We occasionally require a short procurement-only screening call (10–15 minutes) to confirm hosting and data residency statements. Would your security lead be available this Thursday (6/3) from 13:00–13:30 PT?

If those items are in progress, we can tentatively hold the June 15 slot and move to final confirmation once documentation is received. If procurement needs more time, please propose alternative dates in the last two weeks of June.

Attached for reference: lifewell_vendor_intake.pdf (highlighted sections)

Best,
Lifewell Procurement Team
procurement@lifewellhealth.com
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@lifewellhealth.com>, procurement@lifewellhealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-03T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Lifewell — scheduling for product demo

Thanks Samantha — and thanks procurement for the clear asks. Quick plan to keep momentum:

1) NDA: we can sign Lifewell’s mutual NDA today. Laura, can you route the NDA to legal for countersignature (I’ll prioritize).
2) SOC2 / questionnaire: Hannah (cc’d, our security lead) will complete the questionnaire sections you highlighted and attach either the SOC2 redaction or answers by EOD Friday (6/4).
3) Screening call: Hannah can join the procurement-only 13:00–13:30 PT slot this Thursday (6/3) and run through hosting/data-residency specifics. If that time no longer works for procurement, propose one other 30-minute window and we’ll accommodate.

If procurement confirms the screening call and receives the NDA + questionnaire, we’ll keep Tue, June 15 (10:00 PT) as the preferred full-demo date and send a calendar hold. If procurement needs longer, we’ll record a short commercial walkthrough video for Lifewell’s product team in the meantime so they can preview functionality without exposing any sensitive configs.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-4621 (I’ve updated the deal stage to ‘Intake — awaiting security docs’).

Attachments being shared: redwood_vendor_checklist.xlsx

Thanks — we want to avoid a lengthy back-and-forth here and are happy to fast-track the intake items.

—Mateo
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
